text_block_list.text: On the way home after going out with Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, have you ever
encountered a stalker before?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Because at this very moment,
I am being stalked by a certain entity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Listen. Act calm and casually look behind you... up at the sky.

As Agnes Tachyon told me to,
I caaaasually cast a glance behind me.

Perched atop a streetlight just beginning to glow in the twilight,
there sat a single――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did you see it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mm. That is correct—a crow.
I am being stalked by a crow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A few days ago, that crow was tangled up in some fishing line that had been thrown out with the trash.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Like histones wrapped around DNA...
No, according to established theory, that might be slightly off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, regarding the hierarchical structure
of nucleosomes, research is still—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, now I've gotten completely off track.
At any rate, helping them out back then is likely the cause.
choice_data_list: Maybe we could just leave it alone...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see...
Well, you'll understand tomorrow soon enough."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'll stop by the Trainer's office
so that crow can see me.
—And so, the next day.

In the morning, when I approached the window to open
the Trainer's Room curtains, in the small gap of the window was
a massive amount of raw food scraps—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, Trainer-kun?!
How do you like this gift from a crow?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even I couldn't help holding my nose!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right?
The exact same thing was done to my room, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: She dutifully packs them into the window gaps every single day~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-kun.
How do you think we should resolve this situation?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I must be frank. I am in quite a bind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If this were another Umamusume, I could simply have them serve as a test subject in return, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Our subject is a crow! They are not as durable as we are!
It is far too great a risk for a test subject!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer-kun!
Do not hesitate to assist me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No matter how intelligent it may be,
your opponent is still a wild bird, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I don't think words alone are gonna solve this, though... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, there's always a chance
they might sense something from it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it a try for now.
You never know until you try!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, Sir Crow!
I feel your gratitude painfully well!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is more than enough! I am entirely satisfied!
So please, prioritize your own life now!

The crow stared at Agnes Tachyon for a moment,
and then—
With a flap of its wings, it took off and flew away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ohh... Did it actually get through to them?

Afterward, the crow flew away, and intrigued by the fact
that it seemed to understand human speech,
Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I cannot experiment on crows,
but if I were to splice crow genes into you, my Trainer—

"...And with that, she blurted out
something utterly outrageous."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Are you seriously telling me
to eat THAT!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What a terrible person.
That can't even be called an experiment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... If you are my assistant,
you could stand to be a bit gentler with me!

I meant for them to just pretend to take it...
but it seems they misunderstood.

The gifts continued for a while after that, and eventually,
the crow seemed to stop showing up altogether.
Agnes Tachyon was initially exhausted by the daily gifts, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes pretty stones and things would be mixed in.
Well, in its own way... I enjoyed it.

With a faintly lonely smile,
Agnes Tachyon gazed out the window, where no crow was to be seen.
